description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, SharedSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for cross-platform (Linux and Windows) use in the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A cross-platform class for critical section synchronization, managing mutex locking and unlocking.

classes.name: BinarySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore with binary (locked/unlocked) state, supporting lock, unlock, and status check.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that maintains a count, supporting lock, unlock, and try-unlock operations.

classes.name: SharedSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore designed for inter-process sharing, identified by a name or shared memory.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: An event synchronization object supporting manual or automatic reset, set, reset, lock, and unlock.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Lock
methods.description: Locks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: BinarySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Locks the semaphore, blocking until available or timeout.

methods.name: BinarySemaphore::Locked
methods.description: Checks if the semaphore is currently locked.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Locks the semaphore, blocking until available or timeout.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Increments the semaphore count, releasing waiting threads if applicable.

methods.name: SharedSemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the semaphore with a wait time.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event to be set.

methods.name: Event::ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: Event::SetEvent
methods.description: Sets the event to signaled state.

methods.name: Event::IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the event is currently set.

methods.name: SafeSyncType
methods.description: RAII helper for automatic locking and unlocking of synchronization objects.
